For sample order, we suggest to ship by express, such as DHL, UPS, FedEx, etc.; for the bulk order, we can do air shipping, sea shipping, tracking shipping, etc.
How long does it take to deliver an order?

It depends on the style and quantity of the shoes.
Normally, 3-5 days for the ready stock shoes order, 15-30days for the customization order.
If there is a delay, we will notify you in advance about the situation and solution.
